sources.quote: Pro-democracy advocate Francisco Madero, who came from a wealthy family of landowners and industrialists, decided to challenge Díaz in the 1910 presidential race. sources.title: Jesse Greenspan, 6 Things You May Not Know About the Mexican Revolution, HISTORY (published Nov 20, 2012; updated May 28, 2025)
sources.quote: Under his reign, foreign capital flooded into the country and extensive infrastructure modernizations took place. fact: 1917年墨西哥宪法确立八小时工作制、最低工资与罢工权，赋予农民土地再分配与限制地产规模的机制，并含有限制外国投资的条款——这是对1910年外国特许经营模式的事后法律约束。

sources.title: Jesse Greenspan, 6 Things You May Not Know About the Mexican Revolution, HISTORY (published Nov 20, 2012; updated May 28, 2025)
sources.quote: Urban workers received an eight-hour workday, a minimum wage and the right to strike, while peasants gained mechanisms for land redistribution and limiting the size of estates. Another provision restricted foreign investment.
